classification: Post-event continuation of the frozen direct categorical forecaster; historical development and exploratory comparison, separately registered future test

questions.primary: Does a lower-rate categorical CE continuation improve seven-day forecasts relative to the frozen v19 operational checkpoint?
questions.secondary: Does a broader verified training corpus improve forecasts relative to an otherwise matched same-data continuation?
questions.attribution: No isolated learning-rate claim: continuation changes update count and learning rate jointly. Expanded versus same-data isolates corpus under matched continuation settings.

arms.expanded: Original windows plus compatible additional H100/A100 training windows; same CE format and matched update budget

model.seed_meaning: All arms and ordering seeds share exactly the operational seed17 parent weights and optimizer. Seeds change continuation data order only, not LoRA initialization.
model.optimizer_restore: create_training_client_from_state_with_optimizer; failure gates training, no silent reset
model.output: Unchanged frozen 19 relative future-price levels, including exact zero return; same renderer, input, conditional probability extraction and quantile convention

data.selection: Retain every original training task. Add source/provider/family/instrument/tier groups by metadata-only round robin and uniformly spaced eligible origins. Deduplicate exact task IDs. Global cap by round robin, never price-change outcomes.
data.input_features: Existing own-price input only; market fields withheld exactly as v19. No news, BLS, calibration, new heads or archive transfer.
data.aws_archive: Not ingested. Afhubbard source-reported spot quotes retain their own identity; do not apply the separate AWS archive hole to genuine observations from another collector.
data.historical_availability: Source-reported snapshot timestamps in the frozen pack; independent historical publication availability and base-model pretraining exposure remain unverified

training.order: Deterministic cyclic shuffled horizon-example stream; epoch permutation seed = ordering_seed + epoch*1000003. Both arms start at offset480. Batch size16, wrap across epochs without short batches. Record full100-batch task/horizon identity hash and repeated exposures.
training.selection: Lowest development seven-day pinball; update0 eligible; earliest update exact tie. Four equal opportunities for each updated arm.
training.continuation_gate: After seed17 pilot: at least one eligible updated arm selects update>0 with development seven-day loss <=0.98 times the shared incumbent and no extra development failures. Only then run ordering seeds29/43.
training.data_effect_gate: Report separately whether expanded seed17 development loss <=0.98 times matched same-data loss; this is not required to fabricate or claim a data benefit.
training.retrospective: Only each selected checkpoint receives one additional exploratory retrospective evaluation, after saved selection. Existing opened dates cannot select a model or seed.
training.further_search: No automatic rate sweep, budget extension, output change, reward optimization or third intervention

limitations: Two reused development origins and three dependent exploratory origins
More examples can remain correlated; sample counts are not independent market experiments
Corpus and source shifts require explicit reporting
A successful development screen is not prospective improvement
Tinker private resource identity hashes are not weight-byte checksums
